title: CmdPal: More button is visible when there's not enough commands
author: jiripolasek
summary: CmdPal shows a More button when only primary and secondary commands exist; assigned maintainer ownership and open PR 49769 cover the reported case.

status.label: Handled elsewhere / already owned
status.detail: The issue is assigned and linked to open PR 49769, whose patch hides More only when no additional commands remain.

next_action.label: Track linked PR 49769
next_action.reason: The current code change and regression tests are already proposed in the linked open PR.

fix_assessment.rationale: Open PR 49769 directly addresses the reported redundant More button, preserves the context menu for a single secondary command, and adds unit coverage for one versus multiple More commands.

judgment.rationale: The issue is assigned to the CmdPal maintainer and cross-referenced by open PR 49769, whose changed symbols and tests directly cover the reported visibility condition.
evidence: Observed: the issue reports the More button for an item with only primary and secondary commands.
Observed: the issue is assigned to jiripolasek.
Observed: the latest maintainer comment says More should appear only when commands overflow beyond the dedicated primary and secondary buttons.
Observed: open PR 49769 changes CommandBarViewModel.ShouldShowMoreCommandsButton, the CommandBar XAML binding, and adds tests for single versus multiple More commands.
Inferred: the issue can be tracked through PR 49769 rather than receiving a second implementation.
judgment.recommended_action: Track PR 49769 through review and merge; do not open a parallel fix.
